$comment: Coco's Awakening, invitation page. Frames are on one 60 fps master timeline (frame / fps = seconds into the take). Adult Coco's take: blender/scripts/build_coco_invite.py (the clip 'invite', played on models/characters/coco-sage.glb; from its last frame, 'arrive', he breathes and floats with that model's own 'breathe' and 'float'). The magic cloud: blender/scripts/build_magic_cloud.py.

invite.note: his ride in from stage left (the rig alone; it binds to coco-sage.glb by bone name). It ends on breathe frame 0, pose and velocity, where the site hands over to 'breathe' and 'float'.

transform.note: the magic cloud (blender/scripts/build_magic_cloud.py); its own time 0 is master frame startFrame

ride.note: the cloud he rides in on (blender/scripts/build_ride_cloud.py): it follows his root bone, and from 'glow' it swells into the magic cloud and thins away inside it before he is hidden.

cloud.$comment: The magic cloud (blender/scripts/build_magic_cloud.py), in the same frame as Adult Coco (glTF axes, metres). He is fully hidden from hiddenFrom to hiddenTo, coverFrame included (coverage masks with the site's camera, blender/scripts/check_cloud_cover.py). ctl_glow and ctl_fade carry glow and opacity as scale.x. adultBox: Adult Coco seated at his place, sun and bolt included.
